name: JG_FSCL_DOC_GEN_ERRORS_ALL
description: This table contains errors found before sending the fiscal document to fiscal authority such as tax calculation error.

columns.name: ERROR_ID
columns.description: Identifier for text that communicates an error or violation.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction, which indicates the type of transaction being created.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction, such as requisition, purchase order and agreement, and release.

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: System-generated identification number of a transaction.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier of the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Transaction line detail identifier of the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Level at which the transaction line identifier is stored. Possible values are Line, Shipment, and Freight.

columns.name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Standard message name for the validation error.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Fiscal document status associated with the transaction, such as in process, sent, finalized, error, denied, or void.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_KEY
columns.description: Fiscal document access key composed by concatenation of fiscal document number and other fiscal document information. It is used as unique identifier for the tax authority system.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_TYPE
columns.description: Fiscal document type of the transaction. Possible values are Remittance Fiscal Document, Symbolic Remittance Fiscal Document, and Sale Fiscal Document.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEXT
columns.description: Message text associated with the error code.

columns.name: MESSAGE_CAUSE
columns.description: Message cause associated with the error code.

columns.name: MESSAGE_USER_ACTION
columns.description: User action associated with the error code.
